title: Flutter: graph zone widget — node map rendering for territory games
description: BaizeGraph widget renders graph zones (Risk, Clue, Scotland Yard, Pandemic). Nodes positioned by layout algorithm or explicit coordinates from game definition. Edges drawn between connected nodes. Node fill/border indicates ownership/state. Component tokens drawn on nodes. Tap node to select, drag between nodes for movement. Supports node_properties for visual hints (continent color, city size).
